𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) will undertake rotomilling and asphalt overlay activities on the following roads starting from October 1 to 31:

1. Aurora Boulevard (Eastbound), from G. Araneta Avenue (Cubao Area) to 20th Ave. and from fronting PSBA (Before C5 Katipunan Ave.) to Quezon City and Marikina Boundary
2. G. Araneta Avenue (Southbound), from corner Aurora Boulevard to corner N. Domingo Street, Quezon City
3. C5 Katipunan Avenue (Southbound), from opposite corner Capitol Hills Drive to corner C.P Garcia Avenue, Quezon City
4. Quezon Avenue (Eastbound), from fronting Geomachine Co., to corner Scout Santiago Street, Quezon City
5. Quezon Avenue (Eastbound), fronting Hi-top Supermart to fronting BIR, Quezon City
6. C5 Katipunan Avenue (Southbound), from opposite corner Capitol Hills Drive to corner C.P Garcia Avenue, Quezon City

The activities will be done during night-time only from 11 pm until 5 am.

Motorists are advised to take alternate routes.
